expectations.text: Plan prescribes a web prototype validated with real users BEFORE building native
expectations.evidence: Step 2: 'Do not open a mobile builder yet... Two days: build a clickable web version... One full week: put it in front of real target users' precedes any native step

expectations.text: Plan instructs flow-by-flow building with a per-flow spec/PRD, explicitly against one giant prompt
expectations.evidence: Step 5 PRD per flow; Step 7: 'One flow at a time... Never ask for the whole app in one prompt'

expectations.text: Mentions testing with 5-7 real people before release
expectations.evidence: Step 8: 'Test with 5-7 real people before any release and collect feedback from each person individually'

expectations.text: Covers BOTH stores: Apple ($99/yr, TestFlight) and Google Play ($25, closed testing requirement)
expectations.evidence: Step 8: 'Apple Developer Program, $99/year... TestFlight' and 'Google: Play developer registration, $25 one-time... closed test with 12 testers for 14 days'
